column1: # not used by the published analysis. A copy of assets/references/lowinput_s1.tsv
# in which the two contig-level yeast assemblies (exact strains) are replaced by
# complete, chromosome-level genomes of other strains: S. cerevisiae S288C and
# C. neoformans H99. Arm B of the fragmentation test.
# ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community DNA Standard II (Log Distribution), D6311,
# sequenced with a lambda genomic carrier under depletion-mode adaptive sampling.
#   sample      -- a member of the mock community (the DNA we are trying to enrich)
#   carrier     -- the genomic carrier added to reach library-prep input mass
#   contaminant -- organism carried over from carrier production, not part of the community
# theoretical_dna_fraction is the manufacturer's genomic-DNA fraction, and sums
# to 1.0 across role=sample rows. Carrier/contaminant rows are 0 by definition.
# NOTE: this set contains E. coli in BOTH roles. Zymo's community strain
# (B-1109, 4,925,141 bp) and the lambda-prep background (K-12 MG1655,
# 4,641,652 bp) are distinct strains, so reads can be partitioned between them
# rather than discarded wholesale. See docs/ecoli-partitioning.md.
